body:
We sat in the tent, after not having eaten all day sharing out all the pills equally (which we filled the night before with Peruvian Torch Cacti).
17:00: We share round a cigar and have a leaf of chewing tobacco.
18:00: Ate 45 pills of Peruvian Torch cacti and start getting excited about what is coming. We sit and talk. After a minute or two I start feeling a little ill because of all the water I drank while eating the pills.
18:30 We smoke some hash, enough to get us quite happily stoned, start giggling and have an Easter egg hunt. Get more excited about the trip.
20:00: the three other people who took the pills say they are feeling things. I am still just stoned. In about half an hour they say they are conscious of their whole body and was almost like they could see through their legs. They start getting paranoid.
21:00 One person says they see cartoon characters and have flashbacks from when they were young, I am still feeling nothing of the cacti. We go outside for a wander round and remember we hid the egg, we find it.
22:00 We light up some more hash in the bong and get stoned for a second time, this time it is more of a relaxed stone by half ten we are starting to lie down.
23:00: We are all lying down but getting extremely paranoid about things outside (e.g. Thinking an owl is people coming to get us, monsters attacking the nearby town) I try comforting my girlfriend as she is really scared, and though I am paranoid, I am having no such 'trip'.
00:00: It is really really cold and we are lying at an awkward angle so we move round, my head feels all heavy and extremely disorientated, but still no visuals of any kind. I am only one who took the cacti not seeing anything. My kidneys start hurting.
01:00 Still cant sleep, too cold, keep moving round and comforting girlfriend.
02:00 still nothing but others say they think they might have peaked.
03:00 finally get to sleep, though others do not.
07:00 wake up and put some music on, start ranting about how I hate myself because I cant trip, say I think I am dying cos of my kidney (I had serious kidney problems as a child which nearly resulted in death).
08:00 We finish off the hash and start smoking the Amanita muscaria, this leaves senses weird and adds to the stone. Quite a pleasant smoke.
09:00 go on a walk while stoned and have a great time doing some dancing and joking about a song. Kidney really hurting.
12:00 go home, finally eat something and sleep. Kidney in absolute agony, thinking of going to hospital.
Next day, kidney feels better initially but as day gets on feeling worse and worse. In the evening I start feeling all tingly and find it hard to focus on things, initial thoughts were maybe the pills were really slow, but feeling dies away and eventually am almost back to normal.
Can not work out what went wrong, and am very disappointed =(
